'''Pyre's ship''' was an [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]] used by [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] of the [[First Order]] during the [[Cold War]] to travel to and from ''[[Colossus]]''.<ref name="The Children from Tehar" />
